description.text: Training Objectives ：This major aims to cultivate international students with professional ethics and social responsibility, innovative consciousness, teamwork spirit and international perspective, solid knowledge and skills in business management, economics and trade, etc., strong language advantages and familiarity with Chinese culture, as well as good communication skills. Innovative and applied international business management professionals who can engage in trade, operation and management in various organizational forms of enterprises and institutionsCore Courses: Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Principles of Management, Operations Research, Management Information System, Accounting, Statistics, International Marketing, Operations Management, Strategic Management of Enterprises, Innovation Management, Financial Management, etc

duration.text: The Business Administration at Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. NJUPT application form2. high school graduation certificate3. high school transcript4. passport5. passport-sized photo6. resume7. FOREIGNER PHYSICAL EXAMINATION FORM8. award certificate （or HSK certificate）9. bank statement(over 2500USD)

requirements.text: NonNon-Chinese citizens, in good physical and mental healthApplicants seeking a bachelor's degree should possess a high school diplomaor equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 25 years.Applicants seeking a master's degree should possess a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 35 years.Applicants seeking bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degrees with English as the medium of instruction should have an English proficiency level of at least 5.5 in IELTS, 72 in TOEFL, or 100 in Duolingo-Chinese citizens, in good physical and mental health
